notes.general_comments:

30 questions correctly, and two others each produced 25 correct answers. With just 4 candidates, it would
not be appropriate or meaningful to subject each of the individual items to the statistical tests normally
applied to multiple choice papers. Suffice it to say that none of the 30 items were answered incorrectly by all
